entities.summary: Tiit Aleksejev (b. 1968-07-06, Kohtla-Järve) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kohtla-Järve. Known in the fields of journalists & chroniclers.
